ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.16.1 is the Pathfinding Framework compatibility hotfix for the bounded-risk aggressive-parallel playtest. V0.4.16 introduced per-Pawn Reachability profiles, but its compatibility guard correctly noticed Pathfinding Framework on Reachability.CanReach and was too conservative: PF v0.5.x places a diagnostics-only Postfix there which records the final result for error reports without changing it. V0.4.16.1 whitelists only that exact owner + Postfix method; every other foreign Reachability patch remains blocking. PF's gameplay-authoritative Region.Allows movement-type transpiler remains in force because RimMT captures live Region.Allows decisions on the main thread before workers build immutable connectivity profiles. Fresh profiles still begin with shadow validation, are periodically sampled against Vanilla, and automatically cool down/fuse off on parity mismatches. VFE Phasing retains earlier-prefix authority. Worker threads do not commit Pawn jobs, reservations or gameplay-state mutations. V0.4.15 scheduler fan-out, V0.4.14 persistent map fabric, hauling acceleration, path-shadow diagnostics and Butter++ logical-tick barriers remain enabled.
